title: How Bolden differed from earlier reading bands
summary: Earlier bands were all readers; Bolden could hear a piece and have his band playing it by daylight.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Before him? Yeah. Well the other bands, all of them was, what's it called, readers. They was all readers, huh?
Mm, all of them was readers.

But Buddy Bowling, he could hear a band play, or hear music, and come with his band, get his band out with it, in between dances in the night, and before daylight he wanted, he played that piece he heard down there. Mm-hmm.
And that's what made him a guy. Mm-hmm.
